_about: Plain-language descriptions shown on atlas cards. Conservative 'involved in' phrasing (brief §4.7); these replace regions.json function_plain at build time. Edit here, then run npm run brain.
bankssts: Involved in perceiving speech, voices, and biological motion.
caudalanteriorcingulate: Involved in noticing conflicts and errors, and in effortful control.
caudalmiddlefrontal: Includes the frontal eye fields; involved in directing attention and in working memory.
cuneus: Involved in early visual processing, mainly for the lower visual field.
entorhinal: A major input to the hippocampus; involved in spatial and episodic memory.
fusiform: Involved in recognizing faces, written words, and objects.
inferiorparietal: Involved in reading, number processing, and reorienting attention.
inferiortemporal: Involved in recognizing visual objects and categories.
isthmuscingulate: Includes retrosplenial cortex; involved in navigation and autobiographical memory.
lateraloccipital: Involved in perceiving object shape and visual motion.
lateralorbitofrontal: Involved in weighing rewards and punishments, and in flexible decisions.
lingual: Involved in visual processing, mainly for the upper visual field.
medialorbitofrontal: Involved in valuing options and in emotion-guided decisions.
middletemporal: Involved in word meaning and language comprehension.
parahippocampal: Involved in recognizing places and scenes, and in forming new memories.
paracentral: Involved in movement and sensation of the legs and feet.
parsopercularis: Part of Broca's area; involved in planning speech.
parsorbitalis: Involved in language meaning and in retrieving word meanings.
parstriangularis: Part of Broca's area; involved in selecting words and meanings.
postcentral: Contains primary somatosensory cortex; involved in touch and body position.
posteriorcingulate: A core part of the default-mode network; involved in memory and self-referential thought.
precentral: Contains primary motor cortex; involved in voluntary movement.
precuneus: Involved in mental imagery and episodic memory.
rostralmiddlefrontal: Part of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex; involved in working memory and planning.
superiorfrontal: Includes the supplementary motor area; involved in high-level control of action.
superiorparietal: Involved in spatial attention and in guiding reaching movements.
superiortemporal: Involved in hearing and speech perception.
supramarginal: Involved in sound-based language processing and tool use.
frontalpole: Involved in abstract reasoning and in managing several goals at once.
temporalpole: Involved in social and emotional knowledge, including naming people.
insula: Involved in sensing the body's internal state, taste, and emotion.
